title: Grilled Argentinian Beef Skewers
description: A gluten-free recipe for juicy and flavorful beef skewers, inspired by Argentinian cuisine. These char-grilled skewers are perfect for a summer BBQ or outdoor gathering.

ingredients.name: Beef (skewers, 1 inch pieces)
ingredients.notes: Choose a tender cut such as sirloin or flank steak

ingredients.name: Zest of 1 lime
ingredients.notes: Use a zester or fine grater

instructions: Thread beef, onion, and bell pepper onto skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together lime zest, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Add the skewers to the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the beef reaches 135°F for medium-rare.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with chimichurri sauce for dipping.
